products.nameAr: Oud Mood 30ml by Lattafa EDP Unisex
products.nameEn: Oud Mood 30ml by Lattafa EDP Unisex
products.descriptionEn:
Oud Mood 30ml by Lattafa EDP Unisex
Lattafa Oud Mood in the 30ml size offers a rich fragrance experience in a bottle that is easy to carry. Rose, saffron and pimento give the opening a warm floral-spicy feel. At the heart, oud meets caramel, floral notes and patchouli, balancing woody depth with sweetness. Amber, resins, incense, musk and other woods complete the smoky, comforting finish. Consider this Eau de Parfum for evening dinners, special plans or whenever you prefer a bolder oriental profile over light fresh scents. The compact 30ml format also makes it practical to pack for travel. Explore Oud Mood at Sham perfume.
Fragrance Notes
Top: Rose, Saffron, Pimento
Middle: Agarwood (Oud), Caramel, Floral Notes, Patchouli
Base: Woody Notes, Amber, Resins, Incense, Musk

products.nameAr: Hawas Ice by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.nameEn: Hawas Ice by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.descriptionEn:
Hawas Ice by Rasasi – 100ml
Hawas Ice opens with crisp green apple, Italian bergamot and bright lemon, accented by aromatic star anise. Orange blossom joins marine notes, plum and cardamom in the heart, giving the scent both watery freshness and a subtle fruity-spicy dimension. Moss, driftwood, amber and musk define the base, replacing the Hawas's warmer patchouli direction with a cooler, mossy impression. The fragrance balances citrus, crisp fruit and woods without depending on dense sweetness. Ice suits those who enjoy aromatic freshness but want more variety than a simple lemon scent. This 100ml Eau de Parfum is a flanker in the Hawas collection.

products.nameAr: Hawas Malibu by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.nameEn: Hawas Malibu by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.descriptionEn:
Hawas Malibu by Rasasi – 100ml
Pineapple gives Hawas Malibu a bright, tropical character, sharpened by orange and tangy grapefruit. This bright fruit opening gradually reveals a softer centre of amber, iris and lavender. The floral-powdery quality of iris keeps the composition from remaining juicy, while lavender contributes a clean aromatic edge. In the base, tonka bean and musk bring warmth; patchouli adds a gentle woody finish. Malibu balances playful fruit with a settled amber character rather than relying on coconut-heavy sweetness. It suits someone looking for a fresh fruity fragrance with a warm transition from daytime to evening. Available as a 100ml Eau de Parfum.

products.nameAr: Hawas Verde by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.nameEn: Hawas Verde by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.descriptionEn:
Hawas Verde by Rasasi – 100ml
Lime, rosemary and green apple give Hawas Verde its lively citrus-aromatic character. The lime feels sharp, while apple adds crisp fruit without pushing the composition toward thick sweetness. Rosemary brings an herbal edge that makes the scent recognisably green. Patchouli adds earthiness, and amber introduces a measured warmth behind the fresh notes. Together, these ingredients balance brightness with a grounded woody aspect. Verde is particularly interesting for wearers who prefer herbs and fresh fruit to creamy vanilla or dense gourmand accords. Even so, the contrast between citrus, herbs and patchouli gives the fragrance a distinct identity in the Hawas range.

products.nameAr: Hawas Majestic by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.nameEn: Hawas Majestic by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.descriptionEn:
Hawas Majestic by Rasasi – 100ml
Hawas Majestic combines saffron with citrus, jasmine and green leaves for an opening that feels spicy and bright. The character changes in the middle as mineral notes, ambergris, woody amber and dry woods introduce a textured, almost stony quality. Oakmoss, musk, cedar and fir then create a green forest impression in the base. What distinguishes this fragrance is the contrast between the opening's aromatic lift and its drier, mineral-woody core. It is less focused on sugary fruit than on saffron, amber and the smell of timber. This 100ml Eau de Parfum is for fans of structured woody fragrances with depth.

products.nameAr: Hawas Reina by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.nameEn: Hawas Reina by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.descriptionEn:
Hawas Reina by Rasasi – 100ml
Apricot and pear make Hawas Reina fruity at the start, while cinnamon contributes a gentle spicy warmth. The heart is fuller and floral: jasmine, frangipani and orange blossom meet coconut and a coffee nuance. Vanilla, white musk, amber, sandalwood and sugar then create a creamy, sweet base. The composition moves from juicy stone fruit into tropical flowers before settling into soft woods and vanilla. Coffee adds depth rather than dominating the fragrance. Reina will appeal to those who enjoy floral vanilla scents with a fruity opening and a smooth gourmand touch. It comes in a 100ml Eau de Parfum presentation.

products.nameAr: Hawas Chrome For Him by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.nameEn: Hawas Chrome For Him by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.descriptionEn:
Hawas Chrome For Him by Rasasi – 100ml EDP
Juicy peach, yellow fruits and sweet orange introduce Hawas Chrome For Him, a 100ml Rasasi Eau de Parfum with a distinctly tropical direction. Mango and passion fruit then meet a watery accord in the heart, bringing freshness without turning the scent sharply green. Musk, amber and vanilla add softness underneath the fruit. Chrome is defined by the transition from bright yellow fruits to a smoother, musky finish while keeping the tropical character noticeable.

products.nameAr: Hawas Venom by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.nameEn: Hawas Venom by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.descriptionEn:
Hawas Venom by Rasasi – 100ml
Incense defines Hawas Venom from the first impression, supported by the resinous warmth of labdanum. A leather note sits in the middle and keeps the composition dark rather than floral or fruity. Incense returns in the base alongside patchouli and vanilla, creating continuity between the smoky opening and the softer finish. The vanilla rounds the edges but does not erase the leathery, earthy character. Venom is built around few accords, which makes its direction clear: resin, leather and a touch of sweetness. Presented as a 100ml Eau de Parfum, it is a choice for anyone drawn to incense-led woody fragrances.

products.nameAr: Hawas Nautilus by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.nameEn: Hawas Nautilus by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.descriptionEn:
Hawas Nautilus by Rasasi – 100ml
Hawas Nautilus centres on the smell of the coast. Seawater and ambergris introduce a salty, airy impression that sets the direction of this woody aquatic fragrance. Cypress and cedar create a drier, green-wooded middle, giving structure to the marine accords. Driftwood and sand shape the base with a weathered, shorelike character. There is little emphasis on syrupy fruit or heavy vanilla; the interest comes from the meeting of salt, timber and mineral textures. Its restrained profile makes it a practical option for daytime wear, particularly when a fresh yet distinctly woody fragrance is preferred. Presented in 100ml Eau de Parfum.

products.nameAr: Hawas Private Terra by Rasasi Extrait de Parfum 100ml
products.nameEn: Hawas Private Terra by Rasasi Extrait de Parfum 100ml
products.descriptionEn:
Hawas Private Terra by Rasasi – 100ml Extrait de Parfum
Hawas Private Terra Extrait de Parfum begins with saffron, jasmine and cardamom, combining floral detail with a dry spicy edge. Driftwood, cedarwood and iris give its heart a smooth but structured woody character. Oakmoss and cypriol shape a base that feels earthy, mossy, dry and subtly mineral. Unlike a sweet amber fragrance, Terra keeps its attention on woods, texture and restrained spice. Iris helps soften the sharper facets without removing the dry finish. The contrast of floral spice and moss-covered timber is the composition's defining feature. This 100ml Extrait de Parfum suits those seeking a woody fragrance with understated complexity.

products.nameAr: Hawas Atlantis by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.nameEn: Hawas Atlantis by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.descriptionEn:
Hawas Atlantis by Rasasi – 100ml EDP
Bergamot and green galbanum open Hawas Atlantis with a restrained citrus-herbal impression. Ginger brings a spicy touch to the mineral and salty accords in the heart, creating a marine profile that leans away from sugary fruit. Sandalwood and cedarwood provide a drier woody base. In this 100ml Rasasi Eau de Parfum, the contrast between mineral freshness, aromatic ginger and smooth woods gives Atlantis its coastal-inspired identity.

products.nameAr: Hawas Private Dulce by Rasasi Extrait de Parfum 100ml
products.nameEn: Hawas Private Dulce by Rasasi Extrait de Parfum 100ml
products.descriptionEn:
Hawas Private Dulce by Rasasi – 100ml Extrait de Parfum
Hawas Private Dulce Extrait de Parfum places hazelnut beside passion fruit and pink pepper for a nutty, tart and spicy opening. Cacao, jasmine sambac and coconut form the heart, mixing chocolate richness with floral and creamy accents. Patchouli and vetiver keep the base earthy, while soft musk, tonka bean and caramel contribute softness and sweetness. Dulce's appeal lies in contrast: edible notes are present, but dry woods and green roots prevent a single sugary impression. It is a more textured take on a gourmand scent, moving from toasted nuts toward cacao and caramel. The bottle contains 100ml Extrait de Parfum.

products.nameAr: Hawas Gold Digger by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.nameEn: Hawas Gold Digger by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.descriptionEn:
Hawas Gold Digger by Rasasi – 100ml EDP
Pear and mint give Hawas Gold Digger a bright opening that feels fruity without losing its herbal edge. Lavender and bergamot reinforce the freshness before cinnamon and sage introduce a warmer, aromatic middle. As the scent settles, vanilla meets amber, cedarwood and patchouli. These base notes keep the sweetness grounded in a woody finish rather than letting it become a simple dessert accord. Gold Digger changes character steadily: crisp fruit first, seasoned herbs next, then soft vanilla over dry woods. The combination provides an option for wearers who appreciate recognisable aromatic details alongside a comfortable, gently warm Eau de Parfum.

products.nameAr: Hawas Thunder by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.nameEn: Hawas Thunder by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.descriptionEn:
Hawas Thunder by Rasasi – 100ml
Hawas Thunder begins with apple, bergamot and ginger, with cedarwood and mandarin for a crisp fruity-woody opening. Orange blossom and peony introduce a floral layer in the heart, while maté and patchouli keep the centre green and aromatic. Musk, tonka bean, vanilla, ambergris and cedarwood make the base warmer and smoother. The transition is from sparkling fruit and ginger toward woods with restrained sweetness. Thunder offers several contrasting textures without moving completely into a gourmand style. It suits casual, energetic daytime wear while remaining comfortable on relaxed, informal weekend evenings. It is presented in a 100ml Eau de Parfum bottle.

products.nameAr: Hawas Viper by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.nameEn: Hawas Viper by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.descriptionEn:
Hawas Viper by Rasasi – 100ml EDP
Hawas Viper begins with green notes, davana, saffron and thyme, giving the opening a leafy, aromatic spice. Coffee and cinnamon shape the heart, while violet and raspberry offer a subtle floral-fruit contrast. Tonka bean, musk and gurjan balsam form a warm, resinous base. The transition from green herbs to roasted coffee and balsamic sweetness gives this 100ml Eau de Parfum its darker character without relying on a sharp citrus profile.

products.nameAr: Hawas Kobra by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.nameEn: Hawas Kobra by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.descriptionEn:
Hawas Kobra by Rasasi – 100ml EDP
Ginger leads Hawas Kobra with a crisp, spicy bite, while bergamot and tangerine add a citrus lift. The fragrance then makes an unusual turn towards green tea, neroli and cinnamon. Tea keeps the heart clean and slightly leafy, whereas cinnamon supplies a measured touch of warmth. Musk, woods and amber settle underneath, reducing the brightness without turning the scent overly sweet. The central tea accord distinguishes Kobra from fruit-heavy fragrances in the Hawas family. In a 100ml Eau de Parfum format, it offers a fresh aromatic direction balanced by gentle spice and a restrained, woody conclusion suited to everyday wear.

products.nameAr: Hawas For Him La Mer by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.nameEn: Hawas For Him La Mer by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.descriptionEn:
Hawas For Him La Mer by Rasasi – 100ml EDP
The marine feel of Hawas For Him La Mer comes from contrast rather than a listed seawater accord. Peppermint, mandarin and bergamot establish an aromatic citrus opening with a cool edge. Blackcurrant then adds fruit, while carrot and jasmine contribute an unusual earthy-floral middle. Fig, amber and woody notes settle beneath, creating a warmer finish than the first minty impression suggests. This progression distinguishes La Mer from fragrances that rely only on bright citrus. Its 100ml Rasasi Eau de Parfum blends fresh herbs, dark fruit and subtle earthiness, making the scent especially interesting without the need for exaggerated performance claims.

products.nameAr: Hawas Eclat by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.nameEn: Hawas Eclat by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.descriptionEn:
Hawas Eclat by Rasasi – 100ml EDP
Lychee gives Hawas Eclat a juicy beginning, balanced by bergamot, pear and a small pistachio accent. The heart keeps the composition focused: rose develops beside incense, pairing floral softness with a gentle resinous shadow. Amber, musk and woody notes then shape the base, reducing the fruitiness without removing its warmth. Eclat is notable for its contrast between bright fruit and an understated, gently smoky floral middle. Pistachio appears in the opening rather than turning the whole scent into a heavy nutty dessert. Presented in a 100ml Rasasi Eau de Parfum bottle, it explores a fruity-floral style with an amber foundation.

products.nameAr: Hawas Rouge by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.nameEn: Hawas Rouge by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.descriptionEn:
Hawas Rouge by Rasasi – 100ml
Hawas Rouge explores a richer fruity-floral gourmand profile. Tangerine and raspberry bring brightness to the opening, while chocolate adds an unusual dark sweetness. Rose, orange blossom, tuberose and iris then move the fragrance toward a floral centre. Vanilla, musk, coffee and dry woods create the base, where sweetness meets a roasted, woody impression. The contrast between chocolate in the opening and coffee in the finish gives Rouge its character. It is layered beyond a simple fruit scent, with flowers linking the edible notes. This 100ml Eau de Parfum is suited to people who enjoy warm florals with a dessert-like accent.

products.nameAr: Hawas Lava Gold by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.nameEn: Hawas Lava Gold by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.descriptionEn:
Hawas Lava Gold by Rasasi – 100ml EDP
The contrast between sparkling fruit and darker woods defines Hawas Lava Gold. Pineapple, grapefruit, apple and lemon establish a bright, juicy introduction with a tart citrus edge. Leather, saffron and oud then alter the direction of the scent, while raspberry introduces a small fruity link between the two stages. Amber and patchouli bring warmth below the leather, complemented by moss and a caramel nuance. Instead of maintaining the same freshness throughout, Lava Gold gradually becomes deeper and sweeter. Its layered structure will interest wearers who enjoy a pronounced gradual change from an energetic opening to a more substantial woody finish.

products.nameAr: Hawas Fire by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.nameEn: Hawas Fire by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.descriptionEn:
Hawas Fire by Rasasi – 100ml
Fresh French clary sage gives Hawas Fire an aromatic, herbal opening rather than a sweet fruit introduction. Egyptian jasmine and marine notes emerge in the heart, combining white flowers with a sea-breeze character. Ambergris and amber bring a warmer, subtly salty finish to the base. The composition develops from crisp herbs to watery florals and then to mineral warmth, making the contrast between freshness and amber its central idea. Fire is appealing to those who enjoy aquatic fragrances with more aromatic texture than a citrus cologne. The scent is presented as a 100ml Eau de Parfum in the Hawas collection.

products.nameAr: Hawas Tropical by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.nameEn: Hawas Tropical by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.descriptionEn:
Hawas Tropical by Rasasi – 100ml
Hawas Tropical approaches coconut from a fresh, green angle. Coconut water, fig leaf and ginger create an airy opening, with the ginger adding a lively edge to the leafy notes. Coconut and fig develop in the middle, accompanied by mint that keeps the fragrance from becoming overly creamy. Sandalwood, tonka bean and musk form a smooth base beneath the tropical accord. The effect balances fruit, greenery and soft woods rather than delivering a heavy dessert scent. This offers coconut without excessive sweetness. Hawas Tropical is offered as a 100ml Eau de Parfum with an aromatic green profile for warmer days.

products.nameAr: Hawas Ice Freeze by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.nameEn: Hawas Ice Freeze by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.descriptionEn:
Hawas Ice Freeze by Rasasi – 100ml EDP
Bergamot, mandarin and orange create a lively citrus start for Hawas Ice Freeze. The fruit notes are soon sharpened by ginger and mint, with lily of the valley introducing a delicate floral accent. As the brighter notes fade, sandalwood and musk provide a smoother texture while ambergris adds depth. The contrast is between cooling aromatic freshness and a calm, woody base, not a heavy gourmand sweetness. Ice Freeze is suited to those who prefer citrus scents with a noticeable herbal middle. Its 100ml Eau de Parfum presentation keeps the focus on the complete composition, from zesty opening to soft finish.

products.nameAr: Hawas Highness by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.nameEn: Hawas Highness by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.descriptionEn:
Hawas Highness by Rasasi – 100ml EDP
Hawas Highness begins with citrus, spice and amber appearing together, so warmth is present from the first impression. The floral centre introduces jasmine, violet and rose, moving away from the sharper opening without losing its underlying richness. Cedarwood, vetiver and patchouli create a dry, earthy final stage. What stands out is the arrangement of amber ahead of the flowers, rather than waiting until the base to introduce depth. The resulting profile combines floral softness with an aromatic, woody structure. Highness is a Rasasi 100ml Eau de Parfum for anyone looking beyond a purely sweet floral or a straightforward citrus fragrance.

products.nameAr: Hawas Overdose by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.nameEn: Hawas Overdose by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.descriptionEn:
Hawas Overdose by Rasasi – 100ml
Hawas Overdose takes an aromatic opening into a sweeter, amber-rich direction. Spicy and herbal impressions lead before orange blossom adds a floral accent alongside warm amber and guaiac wood. As the fragrance settles, vanilla, chocolate and praline become more prominent, creating a dessert-like effect without losing the underlying woody texture. Ambergris provides a contrasting mineral warmth in the base. The composition is most distinctive in the shift from dry spice to soft confectionery notes. Those who enjoy gourmand fragrances with an aromatic introduction may appreciate this contrast, especially for evenings or cooler surroundings. The 100ml bottle contains Eau de Parfum.

products.nameAr: Hawas Addiction by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.nameEn: Hawas Addiction by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.descriptionEn:
Hawas Addiction by Rasasi – 100ml EDP
Vanilla, cotton candy, marshmallow, caramel and an ice-cream accord set a dessert-like tone in Hawas Addiction. Coconut milk, vanilla and milk continue that creamy direction through the heart. As the scent develops, amber, cedarwood and moss offer a woody counterweight to the sweetness. This 100ml Rasasi Eau de Parfum is firmly gourmand, yet its base provides a different texture from the confectionery opening. The combination will interest those who prefer milky vanilla styles over citrus-led freshness.

products.nameAr: Hawas Exotic by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.nameEn: Hawas Exotic by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.descriptionEn:
Hawas Exotic by Rasasi – 100ml EDP
Hawas Exotic has a detailed and varied opening, where coconut meets mugwort, lavender, cardamom, carrot and bergamot. That combination introduces creamy, herbal and lightly spicy facets at once. Orris and jasmine lead the floral middle with lily of the valley, freesia and cinnamon adding contrast. The base then shifts towards cypriol, musk, patchouli, ambergris, benzoin and labdanum. These deeper notes give the composition an earthy, resinous finish. Exotic is less straightforward than a conventional citrus scent: its interest comes from the movement between coconut, powdery flowers and textured woods. Rasasi presents this edition in a 100ml Eau de Parfum bottle.

products.nameAr: Hawas Blanche by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.nameEn: Hawas Blanche by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.descriptionEn:
Hawas Blanche by Rasasi – 100ml EDP
Hawas Blanche begins with blackcurrant, mandarin, bergamot and apple, balancing dark berries against crisp citrus fruit. Wormwood and basil then introduce a herbal character, while geranium and patchouli bring floral-green and earthy detail to the middle. Sandalwood, moss, musk and dry woods form a composed base beneath the fruit. Blanche does not stay purely juicy; the herbs gradually change its direction towards a greener, more structured scent. The contrast between blackcurrant and aromatic leaves is the central feature of this edition. Rasasi offers it in a 100ml Eau de Parfum format with a distinct fruity-woody progression rather than heavy sweetness.

products.nameAr: Hawas Love For Her by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.nameEn: Hawas Love For Her by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.descriptionEn:
Hawas Love For Her by Rasasi – 100ml EDP
A peppery sparkle gives Hawas Love For Her its first impression. Pink pepper and cardamom sit alongside mandarin, creating a balance of spice and citrus rather than an entirely sugary opening. Orange blossom, jasmine and ylang ylang take over in the heart, where the fragrance becomes noticeably more floral. Tonka bean, vanilla and praline bring a rounded, nutty sweetness to its later stages. The movement from bright spice to white flowers is central to this composition. It suits anyone drawn to warm florals with a soft gourmand edge, especially when a richer finish is preferable to a purely fresh scent.

products.nameAr: Hawas Diva by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.nameEn: Hawas Diva by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.descriptionEn:
Hawas Diva by Rasasi – 100ml EDP
Hawas Diva by Rasasi opens with red fruits, tart rhubarb and lychee. The rhubarb gives the juicy opening a sharp counterpoint before rose, frankincense and cedar shape a floral-resinous heart. Vanilla, musk and ambergris form the warmer base. Rather than remaining purely fruity, this 100ml Eau de Parfum gradually moves toward rose and soft woods. The contrast between lively lychee, aromatic incense and creamy vanilla is what distinguishes Hawas Diva within the collection.

products.nameAr: Hawas For Him by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.nameEn: Hawas For Him by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.descriptionEn:
Hawas For Him by Rasasi – 100ml
Hawas for Him opens with apple, lemon and bergamot, sharpened by cinnamon. Watery notes give the heart its aquatic signature, while plum, orange blossom and cardamom introduce fruit, florals and gentle spice. Ambergris, musk, patchouli and driftwood anchor the base with a warm finish. The appeal of Hawas lies in its balance: fruit and citrus stay lively without overwhelming the marine notes, and the deeper base adds contrast rather than heavy sweetness. This 100ml Eau de Parfum works as an aromatic aquatic option for those who favour freshness with a spicy, ambery undertone. Its character reflects the Hawas style.

products.nameAr: Hawas London by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.nameEn: Hawas London by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.descriptionEn:
Hawas London by Rasasi – 100ml EDP
Hawas London brings pear into an opening shaped by saffron and pink pepper. The fruit adds a gentle contrast to the dry, aromatic spice, keeping the start from feeling too dense. Rose leads the next stage, supported by frankincense and white flowers that introduce a resinous quality. Beneath this floral heart, pale woods, amber, musk and vanilla form a smooth, warm base. The incense is particularly important: it links the rosy middle to the quieter woody finish. This 100ml Rasasi fragrance offers a nuanced combination of fruit, florals and soft resins without relying on a strongly citrus or marine character.

products.nameAr: Hawas Dreams by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.nameEn: Hawas Dreams by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.descriptionEn:
Hawas Dreams by Rasasi – 100ml EDP
Blood orange sets the tone for Hawas Dreams, supported by grapefruit and citrus notes that keep the first impression vibrant. Jasmine and white musk appear in the middle, softening the sharper fruit with a cleaner floral texture. Vetiver, cedar and iris then create a drier, more grounded foundation. The fragrance follows a clear path from juicy citrus to restrained woods, without adding heavy vanilla or chocolate sweetness. Iris gives the base an understated powdery nuance, while vetiver maintains an earthy edge. Dreams is a Rasasi 100ml Eau de Parfum for those who enjoy citrus brightness with a softer woody conclusion.

products.nameAr: Hawas Boa by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.nameEn: Hawas Boa by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.descriptionEn:
Hawas Boa by Rasasi – 100ml EDP
Pomelo and prickly pear distinguish the opening of Hawas Boa, joined by green apple and orange blossom for a bright fruity-floral effect. Tonka bean and driftwood then introduce a softer, woody middle, with frankincense lending a subtle resinous dimension. Sandalwood, vetiver and vanilla form the warmer base. The result is a gradual shift from crisp fruit towards creamy woods rather than an abrupt turn into heavy sweetness. Boa combines familiar notes with an uncommon fruit pairing, giving its fresh opening a clear identity. Offered as a Rasasi 100ml Eau de Parfum, it retains both airy fruit and a grounded finish.

products.nameAr: Hawas Black For Him by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.nameEn: Hawas Black For Him by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.descriptionEn:
Hawas Black For Him by Rasasi – 100ml EDP
Hawas Black For Him starts with pineapple, grapefruit and bergamot, giving its fruity-woody chypre style a vivid citrus edge. Cedarwood, patchouli and jasmine move the fragrance away from that bright opening, while oakmoss, amber and woody notes establish an earthier base. Pineapple remains an important contrast, but the drier patchouli-and-moss finish is what gives this 100ml Rasasi Eau de Parfum its darker character. It is a fruit-and-woods composition rather than a straightforward sweet tropical scent.

products.nameAr: Hawas Crystelle by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.nameEn: Hawas Crystelle by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.descriptionEn:
Hawas Crystelle by Rasasi – 100ml EDP
Bergamot, grapefruit and elemi give Hawas Crystelle a bright opening with a lightly resinous edge. The middle introduces pepper, lavender, cedarwood and saffron, shifting from citrus into aromatic spice and dry wood. Vanilla, musk, vetiver and tonka bean support the later stages with a warmer, smoother character. What makes Crystelle distinctive is the combination of fresh citrus and peppery saffron rather than relying on fruit sweetness alone. The base remains woody even as the vanilla and tonka soften it. This 100ml Rasasi Eau de Parfum balances a sparkling start, textured aromatic heart and grounded final impression with a defined drydown.

products.nameAr: Hawas Pink by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.nameEn: Hawas Pink by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.descriptionEn:
Hawas Pink by Rasasi – 100ml
Egyptian neroli, cinnamon and nutmeg give Hawas Pink a floral opening with a spicy twist. Orange blossom and tuberose fill the heart, with a marshmallow accord adding a soft, airy sweetness between the flowers. The base introduces vanilla, cotton candy and tonka bean, turning the composition gourmand. The result is not simply a sugary perfume: white florals remain visible through the transition from warm spice to creamy sweetness. Pink is distinctive for how its neroli and tuberose contrast with confectionery notes. This 100ml Eau de Parfum is a choice for people drawn to sweet florals that still retain aromatic detail.

products.nameAr: Hawas Sapphire FB Fragrances Edition by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.nameEn: Hawas Sapphire FB Fragrances Edition by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.descriptionEn:
Hawas Sapphire FB Fragrances Edition by Rasasi – 100ml
Hawas Sapphire FB Fragrances Edition opens with bergamot, blackcurrant and guava, producing a citrus-fruit combination with a tropical twist. Orange blossom softens the transition into the heart, where sandalwood contributes creamy woodiness. The base contains musk, tonka bean and ambergris, replacing the juicy opening with a warmer, more rounded finish. Guava is the distinctive element early on, while the contrast of sandalwood and musk shapes the later stages. Sapphire suits people who enjoy tropical fruit accords but want them anchored by florals and woods. This edition is listed in a 100ml Eau de Parfum bottle, with its edition name retained.

products.nameAr: Hawas Elixir by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.nameEn: Hawas Elixir by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.descriptionEn:
Hawas Elixir by Rasasi – 100ml EDP
Spearmint brings a cool aromatic touch to the opening of Hawas Elixir, joined by bergamot and mugwort. The heart takes a distinctly different direction: dark chocolate and benzoin introduce richness, while lavender maintains a herbal connection to the start. White musk, tonka bean and vanilla create a soft, creamy base beneath the chocolate. Elixir therefore feels neither purely fresh nor entirely dessert-like. Its defining feature is the conversation between minty herbs and warm gourmand notes, with resin adding texture between them. The 100ml Rasasi Eau de Parfum offers a more indulgent contrast than the brighter, fruit-focused fragrances in the range.

products.nameAr: Hawas Glitz by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.nameEn: Hawas Glitz by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.descriptionEn:
Hawas Glitz by Rasasi – 100ml EDP
Hawas Glitz opens with bergamot and pear, given an unexpected twist by a gentle nutty accord. Rose, orris and amber build the floral heart, while orange blossom and geranium add further detail. The finish is softer and more powdery: sandalwood, vanilla, musk and caramel sit beneath the flowers. Rather than a sharp citrus fragrance, Glitz develops a smooth transition from fruit to florals and then to warm sweetness. Orris is important to that transition, lending a powdery impression that carries into the base. The 100ml Rasasi Eau de Parfum will appeal to wearers who enjoy floral scents with creamy depth.

products.nameAr: Hawas Private Luceo by Rasasi Extrait de Parfum 100ml
products.nameEn: Hawas Private Luceo by Rasasi Extrait de Parfum 100ml
products.descriptionEn:
Hawas Private Luceo by Rasasi – 100ml Extrait de Parfum
Ginger, bergamot and lemon provide Hawas Private Luceo with a lively citrus-spice opening. Cardamom and nutmeg bring warmth to the heart, while magnolia adds a softer floral detail. The base turns woody through vetiver, patchouli and cedarwood, with amber rounding out the sharper edges. Luceo is not purely citrus: its freshness gives way to earthy texture as the fragrance develops. The ginger opening remains a useful point of contrast against the darker woods. This balance makes the scent approachable for someone who enjoys fresh spice but dislikes heavy sweetness. Hawas Private Luceo is presented as a 100ml Extrait de Parfum.

products.nameAr: Hawas For Him Alpha by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.nameEn: Hawas For Him Alpha by Rasasi 100ml EDP
products.descriptionEn:
Hawas For Him Alpha by Rasasi – 100ml EDP
Hawas For Him Alpha pairs ginger with pink grapefruit and Calabrian bergamot for an opening that is both tart and spicy. Leather then takes a central position, with jasmine offering a softer floral counterpoint. The listed base combines patchouli and ambergris, bringing an earthy warmth beneath the leather. Alpha is not designed around a long list of sweet fruits; its structure is direct and contrasts citrus freshness with a darker middle. The final impression remains grounded in leather and patchouli, while citrus opening prevents the composition from feeling heavy. This Rasasi edition is presented as a 100ml Eau de Parfum.

products.nameEn: Ana Abiyedh Rouge Lattafa 60ml EDP

products.nameEn: Khamrah Mira by Lattafa
products.descriptionEn:
Khamrah Mira by Lattafa – Unisex Fragrance
Khamrah Mira by Lattafa is an aromatic, gourmand and woody fragrance launched in 2026. It opens with red currant, cinnamon and mandarin, giving a fruity-spiced start. The heart blends jasmine sambac, orange flower and chestnut for a floral, creamy and nutty character. In the dry down, benzoin resin, Tonka Roasted Absolute, Vanilla Madagascar and musk create a rich, warm and gourmand finish.
Fragrance Notes:

Middle: Jasmine Sambac, Orange Flower, Chestnut

products.nameAr: Fearless by Lattafa 100ml EDP Men
products.nameEn: Fearless by Lattafa 100ml EDP Men
products.descriptionEn:
Fearless by Lattafa – 100ml Eau de Parfum for Men
Fearless by Lattafa is a woody aromatic fragrance for men with a bright fruity opening, a cocoa-spice heart and a warm tobacco base. It opens with passion fruit, grapefruit and juniper berry, giving a fresh, tart and aromatic start. The heart blends cocoa, lavender and cinnamon for a warm, aromatic and slightly gourmand character. In the dry down, tobacco, cedarwood, patchouli and benzoin create a rich, woody and resinous finish.
Fragrance Notes:

Middle: Cocoa, Lavender, Cinnamon
Base: Cedarwood, Patchouli, Benzoin

products.nameEn: Blue Oud Elixir by Lattafa 100ml EDP Unisex
products.descriptionEn:
Blue Oud Elixir by Lattafa – 100ml Eau de Parfum Unisex
Blue Oud Elixir by Lattafa is an aromatic woody fragrance with a fresh-spicy opening and a warm, deep base. It opens with bergamot, citrus notes and pepper for a bright, energetic start. The heart combines oud, rosemary and lavender for an aromatic woody character. In the dry down, amber, musk and sandalwood create a smooth, warm and lasting finish.
Fragrance Notes:
Top: Bergamot, Citrus Notes, Pepper
Middle: Oud, Rosemary, Lavender
Base: Amber, Musk, Sandalwood

products.nameAr: Beyond Precious by Lattafa 100ml EDP Women
products.nameEn: Beyond Precious by Lattafa 100ml EDP Women
products.descriptionEn:
Beyond Precious by Lattafa – 100ml Eau de Parfum for Women
Beyond Precious by Lattafa is a soft floral-oriental fruity fragrance with a bright pear-citrus opening and a warm vanilla base. It opens with pear, bergamot and neroli, giving a luminous, fresh and gently sweet start. The heart combines angelica, jasmine and orange blossom for an airy white-floral character. In the dry down, vanilla, tonka bean and immortelle add creamy warmth and a softly honeyed finish.
Fragrance Notes:
Top: Pear, Bergamot, Neroli
Middle: Angelica, Jasmine, Orange Blossom
Base: Vanilla, Tonka Bean, Immortelle

products.nameAr: Bade'e Al Oud Black Exposed Lattafa 100ml
products.nameEn: Bade'e Al Oud Black Exposed Lattafa 100ml
products.descriptionEn:
Bade'e Al Oud Black Exposed by Lattafa – 100ml Eau de Parfum Unisex
Bade'e Al Oud Black Exposed by Lattafa is a dark, warm amber-vanilla fragrance for women and men. It opens with smoky olibanum, sweet toffee and vibrant pink pepper. The heart blends orris, cocoa and Healingwood, creating a powdery, chocolate-like and woody texture. It settles into a smooth base of vanilla, Edenolide and labdanum, leaving a warm, intimate and gently musky trail suited to evenings, date nights and cooler weather.
Fragrance Notes:
Top: Olibanum, Toffee, Pink Pepper
Middle: Orris, Cocoa, Healingwood
Base: Vanilla, Edenolide, Labdanum

products.nameAr: Jouri Lattafa Women 100ml EDP
products.nameEn: Jouri Lattafa Women 100ml EDP
products.descriptionEn:
Jouri by Lattafa – 100ml Eau de Parfum for Women
Jouri by Lattafa is a Floral Fruity fragrance for women with a bright tropical-fruity opening and a smooth sweet dry down. It opens with pitaya, orange and candied cherry, giving the scent a juicy, sparkling and playful start. The heart blends peony, frangipani, raspberry and water lily, adding airy florals, tropical creaminess and a fresh watery touch. In the base, vanilla, tonka and patchouli create a warm, soft and comforting finish.
Fragrance Notes:
Top: Pitaya, Orange, Candied Cherry
Middle: Peony, Frangipani, Raspberry, Water Lily
Base: Vanilla, Tonka, Patchouli

products.nameAr: Opulent Milano by Lattafa 100ml Men
products.nameEn: Opulent Milano by Lattafa 100ml Men
products.descriptionEn:
Opulent Milano by Lattafa – 100ml for Men
Opulent Milano by Lattafa has a fresh, green and polished scent profile built around citrus, aromatic florals and clean woods. It opens with bergamot, pink pepper and Timur for a bright, zesty and lightly spicy start. The heart combines rose, blackcurrant and geranium, adding a crisp fruity-floral character. In the dry down, vetiver, amberwood and cedarwood create a smooth, green and woody finish.
Scent Profile Notes:
Top: Bergamot, Pink Pepper, Timur
Middle: Rose, Blackcurrant, Geranium
Base: Vetiver, Amberwood, Cedarwood

products.nameAr: Sheikh Al Shuyukh Supreme by Lattafa 100ml
products.nameEn: Sheikh Al Shuyukh Supreme by Lattafa 100ml
products.descriptionEn:
Sheikh Al Shuyukh Supreme by Lattafa – 100 ml Eau de Parfum.
Sheikh Al Shuyukh Supreme by Lattafa A rich oriental-woody fragrance with deep amber, smoky woods and warm spices. It opens with cinnamon, rose and saffron, creating a warm blend of spice, floral depth and a refined leathery nuance, vanilla and smoky woods for performance.
The heart combines caramel and patchouli for a sweet, earthy and slightly resinous character.
Vanilla, ambroxan, woody notes and amber form the base, adding creamy sweetness, warmth and lasting depth.
Suitable for men who enjoy bold sweet-spicy fragrances for evening wear and cooler weather

products.nameAr: Maharjan Gold by Lattafa Pride 100ml
products.nameEn: Maharjan Gold by Lattafa Pride 100ml
products.descriptionEn:
Maharjan Gold by Lattafa Pride – 100ml Eau de Parfum for Women and Men.
A warm, spicy and woody fragrance with aromatic florals, smoky incense and a smooth sweet base. It opens with lavender and pepper, creating a fresh aromatic impression with a lively spicy edge. The heart combines jasmine, tuberose and incense, adding white-floral richness and a softly smoky character. Cedarwood, caramel, cashmeran and amber form the base, giving the fragrance warm woods, gentle sweetness and a polished amber finish. Suitable for women and men who enjoy elegant spicy florals with woody and resinous depth.

products.nameAr: Ana Abiyedh Leather 60ml by Lattafa Perfumes
products.nameEn: Ana Abiyedh Leather 60ml by Lattafa Perfumes
products.descriptionEn:
Ana Abiyedh Leather 60ml by Lattafa Perfumes
Ana Abiyedh Leather 60ml by Lattafa Perfumes The fragrance opens with raspberry, saffron, and thyme before revealing a rich heart of olibanum and jasmine. It settles into a deep base of leather, suede, amber, and woody notes, creating a refined leather oriental signature with long-lasting depth.

products.nameAr: Bayaan Eau De Parfum 100ml by Lattafa
products.nameEn: Bayaan Eau De Parfum 100ml by Lattafa
products.descriptionEn:
Bayaan Eau De Parfum 100ml by Lattafa
Bayaan Eau De Parfum 100ml by Lattafa The fragrance opens with cassis, pink pepper, and lychee before unfolding into an elegant heart of rose, cardamom, and praline. It settles into a smooth base of vanilla, moss, oud, and amber, creating a refined fruity floral amber composition with lasting depth.

products.nameAr: Khamrah Waha Lattafa Perfumes 100ml EDP
products.nameEn: Khamrah Waha Lattafa Perfumes 100ml EDP
products.descriptionEn:
Khamrah by Waha Lattafa
Khamrah Waha Lattafa Perfumes 100ml EDP is an aromatic aquatic fragrance designed for those who prefer a fresh, modern and refined scent profile. It opens with a bright blend of bergamot, juniper, yuzu and ginger, delivering a sparkling citrus aromatic introduction with a clean spicy lift. The heart develops into a refreshing composition of iris, cucumber, sage and sea salt accord, adding mineral freshness, soft elegance and a crisp aquatic character. The dry-down settles into Akigalawood, tonka, vanilla, musk and Ambrofix, creating a warm woody base with smooth sweetness depth. This fragrance is suitable for daily wear, office use, warm climates and evening occasions. It offers a fresh yet intense character with balanced projection, making it a versatile unisex scent for those who prefer clean aquatic compositions with a warm modern woody base.

products.nameAr: Choco Musk by Al Rehab 50ml EDP Unisex
products.nameEn: Choco Musk by Al Rehab 50ml EDP Unisex
products.descriptionEn:
Choco Musk by Al Rehab – 50ml Eau de Parfum for Women and Men.
Choco Musk by Al Rehab 50ml A warm gourmand fragrance combining creamy vanilla, chocolate, soft musk and gentle spice. It opens with vanilla and chocolate, creating a sweet and comforting dessert-like character. The heart combines musk, cinnamon and spicy notes for a powdery, warm and softly aromatic effect. Sandalwood, oriental woody notes and rose form the base, adding smooth woods, floral softness and depth. Suitable for women and men who enjoy chocolate-vanilla fragrances with musk, spice and a cozy finish.

Ana Abiyedh Poudree by Lattafa 60ml
Ana Abiyedh Poudree by Lattafa 60ml The fragrance opens with orange blossom, rose, and jasmine before revealing a soft heart of musk and powdery accords. It settles into a smooth base of vanilla, tonka bean, cedarwood, and amber, creating an elegant floral powdery composition with lasting depth.

products.nameAr: Musamam Eau De Parfum 100ml by Lattafa
products.nameEn: Musamam Eau De Parfum 100ml by Lattafa
products.descriptionEn:
